name: Bjørn Arnesen
bio:
Bjørn's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Bergen, where he spent countless hours tinkering with electronics and watching rally races. He pursued a degree in Electrical Engineering at the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, focusing on embedded systems and control algorithms. After graduating, he gained experience at a local engineering firm, but his heart always yearned for the roar of engines and the challenge of pushing the limits of racing technology.

He joined FVee Brasil seeking a more hands-on role, where he could apply his expertise to optimize the performance of their race cars. Bjørn is known for his meticulous approach to problem-solving, his ability to quickly diagnose complex electrical issues, and his relentless pursuit of innovative solutions. He believes that even the smallest improvements in electronic systems can make a significant difference on the track. His demanding nature pushes the team towards perfection, ensuring that every electrical component is functioning at its peak potential.

Bjørn is particularly interested in developing advanced data acquisition systems to improve vehicle dynamics. He is also proficient at finding innovative ways to enhance the reliability of sensors and wiring harnesses, which are often subjected to harsh conditions in motorsport. He is hoping to learn more about managing a team during his time in Brazil.
